title: A change after a deposit was taken in another tab is refused
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer C, another customer to try as Bill To.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Approved, billed to customer B.
  • Open work order 1 in two browser tabs.
custom_steps:
1. In the first tab, expand the Customer card.
  2. Switch to the second tab.
  3. Open the Finance tab.
  4. Click Add Deposit.
  5. Pick a Payment Method.
  6. Enter 10.00 as the Deposit Amount.
  7. Click Submit Deposit.
  8. Switch to the first tab.
  9. Click the Bill To field.
  10. Pick customer C in the list.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer B's name.

Step 2:

  • The second tab shows work order 1 for customer A.

Step 3:

  • The Finance tab shows Add Deposit.

Step 4:

  • The Create Deposit window opens.

Step 5:

  • The Payment Method is picked.

Step 6:

  • Deposit Amount shows 10.00.

Step 7:

  • The $10.00 deposit is recorded.

Step 8:

  • The first tab still shows the field as changeable.

Step 9:

  • The list opens (the page has not refreshed).

Step 10:

  • The change is refused with "This work order has a $10.00 deposit from [customer B's name]. Reverse it, change the Bill To, then take the deposit again under the new Bill To."
  • The message has its "Open Deposits" button.
  • The field refreshes to its locked state, still reading customer B's name.

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as customer B's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12307 (Story 5, Locked Bill To: invoiced and deposits)

  • S5-E2: “If a deposit is taken while the page is open, a change is refused with M1 and its button, and the field refreshes.”
